title: Network Developer 3
description:
**Job Description**
 Supports the design, deployment, and operations of a large\-scale global Oracle cloud computing environment (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure \- OCI). Primarily focused on development and support of network fabric and systems through a combination of a deep level understanding of networking at the protocol level coupled with programming skills to support the intensive automation required to operate a production environment. As OCI is a cloud\-based network with a global footprint, this support will include hundreds of thousands of network devices supporting millions of servers, connected over a mix of dedicated backbone infrastructure and the Internet.
   

  

 The Network Scaling Engineer position is a critical role within our organization, offering a unique opportunity for an experienced networking professional to make a substantial impact. This role is designed to tackle the challenges of scaling and optimizing our global cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 You will be at the forefront of our efforts to expand and enhance our network capabilities, primarily focusing on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Your main responsibility will be to design and implement access fabric networks, ensuring a robust and scalable foundation for our cloud environment. This involves a deep understanding of networking protocols to facilitate seamless connectivity across our vast infrastructure.
   

  

 A significant aspect of your work will involve managing and expanding metro fabrics, which are essential for local performance. This includes the configuration and optimization of optical networks, enabling high\-speed data transmission over long distances. Additionally, you'll oversee external connectivity, managing Edge devices to establish reliable connections with external partners and services.
   

  

 As a key player in our team, you'll lead the way in network migrations, ensuring our infrastructure remains cutting\-edge. This process requires meticulous planning and execution to minimize disruptions and ensure a smooth transition to the latest technology and security standards. Your expertise will be vital in maintaining the network's stability during these critical phases.
   

  

 The role demands collaboration with various teams, as your work will significantly influence the scalability, performance, and reliability of our network. Proficiency in programming is essential, as you'll automate processes to efficiently manage a large\-scale network. Your skills will contribute to streamlining operations and adapting to the evolving demands of the cloud computing landscape.
   

  

 We are seeking an individual with extensive networking knowledge, including protocols and architectures, and practical experience in large\-scale environments. Programming proficiency is a must, as it is integral to our automation\-centric approach. While experience with OCI is preferred, we value adaptability and a strong problem\-solving mindset in a fast\-paced setting.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Network Scaling Engineer, you will embark on a diverse range of responsibilities, each contributing to the overall health and evolution of our network infrastructure. Your role is pivotal in ensuring the network's smooth operation and its ability to adapt to changing demands.
   

  

 You'll actively participate in the network lifecycle, from initial builds to upgrades, collaborating closely with project managers to define and execute strategic milestones. This involves not only following established procedures but also developing new ones to address evolving challenges. As a technical lead, you'll guide your team through these projects, sharing your expertise and mentoring junior engineers.
   

  

 Your input will be invaluable in shaping the network's roadmap, contributing to the development of new features and enhancements. This includes designing network solutions and architectures, ensuring they align with our long\-term goals. You'll also be responsible for creating and updating runbooks, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and standardization.
   

  

 Operational excellence is a key focus. Your troubleshooting skills will be critical in break\-fix scenarios, and you'll lead post\-event analyses to identify root causes and implement preventive measures.
   

  

 Automation is at the heart of our efficiency. You'll collaborate with automation teams to develop and integrate tools, streamlining network management. Your scripting skills, particularly in Python, will be utilized to automate routine tasks, freeing up resources for more complex challenges. As an SME, you'll guide software development projects related to network automation, ensuring they meet our high standards.
   

  

 Vendor management is another crucial aspect. You'll work closely with network vendors to address software bugs and drive resolutions, ensuring our systems are stable and secure. This includes collaborating with vendor technical teams and our internal QA to qualify new firmware and operating systems.
   

  

 The technical requirements for this role are demanding but essential. We seek extensive experience in large\-scale networking, particularly with commodity Ethernet hardware and core protocols such as BGP, OSPF, and TCP/IP. Proficiency in various networking protocols, including TCP/IP, VPN, DNS, and DHCP, is critical. Experience with Internet peering and automation scripting, preferably Python, is highly valued.
   

  

 Additionally, we require knowledge of network modeling, security design, and system performance testing. Your understanding of data flow, telemetry, and their application in large\-scale environments will be beneficial. Strong problem\-solving and communication skills are essential, as you'll influence roadmap decisions and convey complex ideas effectively.
   

  

 In this role, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact, driving our network's growth and reliability while staying at the forefront of networking technology.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Sr. Network Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Do you want to wake up each morning and look forward to going to work? You've found the right career opportunity! Workday's BT Cloud Engineering team is looking for a highly motivated technical lead to join our fun, innovative, and hardworking team. Working with an outstanding group of highly qualified IT professionals, you will be part of a special team that is building the cloud first approach for workmates. We are seeking a skilled and motivated hands on lead who can help BT continue to deliver secure services at scale.. This position is located in Pune, India
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our organization is seeking a highly motivated, experienced, and communicative Senior Network Engineer to join our dynamic IT team.
   

  

* The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in designing, implementing, managing, and troubleshooting complex network infrastructures.
* This role requires a strong background in enterprise\-grade routing and switching (including extensive experience with Cisco IOS/IOS\-XE/NX\-OS operating systems), the comprehensive Juniper Mist AI\-driven wireless platform, Palo Alto Networks firewalls, SD\-WAN, advanced AWS cloud networking (including Gateway Load Balancer, Transit Gateway, VPC Peering, and sophisticated traffic management techniques), and in\-depth Zscaler Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) solutions (including Zscaler Internet Access \- ZIA and Zscaler Private Access \- ZPA).
* You will play a critical role in ensuring the stability, security, and scalability of our enterprise network, including the physical infrastructure of our network distribution frames, and effectively communicating network strategies and issues across the organization.
* This role requires participation in an on\-call rotation to provide 24x7 support.


**About You**
**Basic Qualifications:**
* 8\+ years' total experience
* Design, configure, implement, and maintain enterprise\-level network infrastructure, including routers, switches (campus and data center), firewalls, wireless access points, and related services.
* Design, implement, and manage complex BGP routing solutions, including iBGP/eBGP peering, route reflectors, policy\-based routing, traffic engineering using communities and other attributes, and troubleshooting complex BGP convergence and stability issues.
* Lead the design, build\-out, and ongoing management of Main Distribution Frames (MDFs) and Intermediate Distribution Frames (IDFs), ensuring adherence to structured cabling standards, optimal cable management, power distribution, cooling, and physical security.
* Design, deploy, and manage the Juniper Mist AI\-driven platform (including Mist Access Points, Mist Edge, and the Mist Cloud dashboard for AI\-driven operations, Marvis Virtual Network Assistant, Wi\-Fi Assurance, Wired Assurance, and WAN Assurance).
* Deploy, manage, and optimize Palo Alto Networks' SD\-WAN, firewalls, including policy creation, threat prevention, VPN configuration, and performance tuning.
* Architect, build, and manage secure and scalable network solutions within AWS cloud environments, including:
* Designing and implementing AWS Transit Gateway architectures for large\-scale network connectivity (VPC attachments, Direct Connect Gateway, route propagation, network segmentation, and policy enforcement).
* Setting up and managing AWS Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) for deploying and scaling third\-party virtual appliances.
* Establishing and managing VPC Peering connections (intra\-region and inter\-region) ensuring secure and optimized communication paths.
* Implementing comprehensive AWS traffic management solutions using services like Route 53 (DNS, health checks, routing policies), Elastic Load Balancing (ALB/NLB), and AWS Direct Connect for hybrid connectivity.
* Configuring and managing Security Groups, Network ACLs, and other AWS native security features.
* Implement, configure, and manage Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions, including:
* Setting up and managing identity provider (IdP) integrations (e.g., SAML, SCIM) for robust user authentication and the creation/management of identity\-based security policies and access groups.
* Deploying, managing, and troubleshooting Zscaler Private Service Edges (PSEs) for optimized and secure access to internal applications via ZPA.
* Developing and contributing to Business Continuity Plans (BCP) for Zscaler services, ensuring resilient and continuous secure access for users.
* Configuring traffic forwarding, security policies, and application segments.
* Lead network infrastructure projects from conception to completion, including requirements gathering, design, planning, execution, and post\-implementation support, ensuring clear communication with all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Monitor network performance and integrity using tools like Marvis for proactive insights, identify and resolve complex network issues (leveraging deep troubleshooting skills for routing, switching, firewalling, cloud networking, and SASE solutions), and implement proactive measures to prevent outages and performance degradation.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, IDF/MDF layouts, Zscaler policy and architecture details, operational procedures, and present technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
* Effectively collaborate and communicate with cross\-functional teams (Security, Systems, Applications, DevOps, Facilities) to ensure network infrastructure supports business requirements and strategic initiatives.
* Perform network capacity planning and recommend upgrades and enhancements to meet evolving business needs, articulating justifications and benefits clearly.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for after\-hours support and respond to critical network incidents, providing 24x7 operational support as needed, communicating status and resolution effectively.


**Other Qualifications:**
* Stay current with emerging network technologies, security threats, and industry best practices.
* Mentor junior network engineers and provide technical guidance and support, fostering their communication and technical skills.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CCNP (Enterprise/Data Center/Security), CCIE (Enterprise Infrastructure/Security), JNCIP\-ENT, Juniper Networks Certified Mist AI Specialist (JNCIS\-MistAI) or Professional (JNCIP\-MistAI), PCNSE, AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP\-PA, ZCCP\-IA) or Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA\-PA, ZCCA\-IA).
* Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, Ansible) for network tasks, including AWS CloudFormation or Terraform for infrastructure as code.
* Knowledge of SD\-WAN technologies.
* Familiarity with other cloud platforms (Azure, GCP).
* Experience with network segmentation and micro\-segmentation strategies.


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 At Workday, we are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience where all candidates can fully demonstrate their skills. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point, please email accommodations@workday.com.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
 At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
   

  

 Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.
   

  

 In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

Job Role: Level 2 Network Engineer (Operations Team)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

 Oversee network performance, ensuring uptime and optimal configurations across Cisco Meraki, FortiGate, Cisco, any public cloud net ops, Cisco ISE and SD\-WAN environments.
   

  

 Manage Cisco ACI and Cisco Nexus environments, ensuring optimal performance and scalability.
   

  

 Identify, analyze, and resolve network performance bottlenecks and recommend enhancements.
   

  

 Monitor and maintain network health, proactively identifying and resolving issues related to ACI, Nexus switches, and routing.

 Act as the escalation point for Level 1 engineers, resolving advanced incidents related to firewalls, DNS, Zscaler, SD\-WAN, and load balancers (NetScaler/F5\).
   

  

 Diagnose and resolve network\-related application issues, including advanced routing, S2S VPNs, and traffic shaping problems.
   

  

 Configure and troubleshoot BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) and OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) routing protocols within the network infrastructure.
   

  

 Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and provide actionable recommendations to prevent future occurrences.
   

  

 Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) for network access control, device authentication, and security policy enforcement across the network.

 Design and implement advanced configurations for firewalls, load balancers, SD\-WAN, and Zscaler to meet business needs.
   

  

 Manage and maintain DNS records, including advanced configurations like load balancing, failover, and CDN integrations.
   

  

 Assist in planning and executing network upgrades, migrations, and deployments for multi\-site environments.
   

  

 Ensure high availability and redundancy of network components, including ACI fabric, Nexus switches, and routing protocols.
   

  

* Security and Compliance:


 Implement and manage complex firewall rules, VPNs.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with security standards, conducting regular audits and vulnerability assessments on network devices.
   

  

 Support Zscaler policy configuration and integration with other network security tools.
   

  

* Collaboration and Mentorship:


 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to implement network changes with minimal disruption.
   

  

 Mentor Level 1 engineers by providing training, guidance, and support to improve team skill levels.
   

  

 Liaise with vendors for escalated support, product updates, and feature enablement.
   

  

* Documentation and Reporting:


 Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for network infrastructure, configurations, and processes.
   

  

 Generate in\-depth reports on network performance, incident resolution, and system health for stakeholders.
   

  

 Maintain updated diagrams and records of network topology and architecture.
   

  

* Strategic Contributions:


 Participate in network architecture design discussions, providing insights and recommendations.
   

  

 Evaluate and recommend new tools, technologies, and processes to improve operational efficiency.
   

  

 Lead small\-scale projects involving network optimization, hardware refreshes, or policy implementations.
   

  

* Disaster Recovery and Backup:


 Manage backup and restoration processes for firewalls, DNS servers, load balancers, and SD\-WAN devices.
   

  

 Play a key role in disaster recovery planning and execution, ensuring rapid restoration of services.
   

  

**Skills And Qualifications**
 Technical Expertise:
   

  

 In\-depth experience with Cisco Meraki, FortiGate or CheckPoint or Cisco firewall.
   

  

 Strong expertise in Cisco ACI (Application Centric Infrastructure) and Cisco Nexus series switches.
   

  

 Proficiency in SD\-WAN technologies, including advanced routing and policy configurations.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Zscaler deployment and advanced policy management.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of load balancers like NetScaler and F5, including traffic steering and SSL offloading.
   

  

 In\-depth understanding and hands\-on experience with BGP and OSPF routing protocols.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) for network access control and security policy enforcement.
   

  

**Tools And Platforms**
 Proficiency with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Wireshark)
   

  

 Familiarity with firewall management systems (e.g., FortiManager, Cisco FMC, ASDM) and SD\-WAN controllers.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview \& Key Responsibilities)**
**How you’ll help us Keep Climbing (overview \& key responsibilities):**
* Responsible for overall development, authoring, and management of aircraft work cards for all Delta Air Lines fleets in accordance with FAA\-approved programs and engineering documents.
* Must ensure compliance to FAA Regulations, Engineering documentation, and other substantiating data as outlined in the Technical Operation Policies \& Procedures (TOPP).
* Monitor workflow for compliance and conduct internal audits to ensure regulatory adherence.
* Collaborate with departments including Maintenance, Quality Assurance, Engineering, and Production Control to maintain Delta standards.
* Ensure work cards comply with FARs, Airworthiness Directives (ADs), and fleet maintenance program procedures.
* Incorporate safety\-conscious behaviors into all operational processes and work card content.
* Revise and coordinate changes with the Lower Order Check Program to maintain compliance with Technical Operations Policy and Procedures (TOPP).
* Complete Maintenance Data Change Requests through Delta\-approved applications and track progress for completeness.
* Review existing work cards and related documents for compliance with Delta and regulatory standards.
* Perform “Second Set of Eyes” reviews for new and existing projects.
* Develop strategic and tactical plans fostering a safety\-conscious environment for employee well\-being.
* Work in collaboration with Senior engineers within the team in meeting business objectives.
* Position requires a thorough knowledge of commercial aviation documentation and guidance specifications (i.e. ATA 100, iSpec2200, S1000D, and etc).


**Role Summary**
 The Technical Writer will be responsible for the following support of Delta’s Technical Operations division.
   

  

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**
**What you need to succeed (minimum qualifications):**
* Aircraft Maintenance Engineering license (or applicable degree) with direct experience as a Technical Writer.
* 4\-8 years of experience in total inclusive of AME and Technical writer within the Aviation sector (Aircraft Structures, Systems and Propulsion)
* Must have previous aircraft maintenance experience with thorough knowledge and understanding of aircraft manuals (Aircraft Maintenance Manual (AMM), Illustrated Parts Catalog (IPC), Engine Maintenance Manual (EMM), etc. used for inspecting, troubleshooting and repairing of aircraft and engines.
* Should be a self\-starter with excellent written and verbal communications skills, able to handle several projects simultaneously with minimum supervision, must be well\-organized, and able to prioritize work to meet established deadlines.
* Ability to interpret task requirements and develop safe, effective, and compliant maintenance procedures.
* Must have very strong computer skills with knowledge and experience in structured authoring preferred (SGML, S1000D, XML, and etc).
* Must embrace diverse people, thinking, and styles.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Ability to work in collaborative environments and embrace diverse perspectives.
* Communicate clearly and concisely, express thoughts and ideas effectively, and embrace cultural differences with respect when engaging with others.
* Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build strong partnerships.
* Prioritize, maintain focus, and consistently deliver commitment.
* Proactively understand customer expectations and willingness to create customer\-based solutions.


**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**
**What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):**
* Experience in MS Office products, Epic Editor, CORENA Studio, MS Office products and Adobe Professional highly preferred.


**About The Company**
**Delta Air Lines** 
 (NYSE: DAL) is the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability and customer experience. Powered by our employees around the world, Delta has for a decade led the airline industry in operational excellence while maintaining our reputation for award\-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
   

  

 In 2024, Delta was recognized by Fortune with a No. 11 placement on
 **Fortune’s Top 50 Most Admired Companies** 
 list. The company’s strong management and commitment to providing elevated experiences and premium products also secured a No. 1 ranking out of the eight airlines on the list. Delta landed on
 **TIME’s** 
 inaugural list of the
 **“World’s Best Companies,”** 
 coming in at No. 12 – the only U.S. airline in the top 155\. TIME’s award is based on three criteria: employee satisfaction, revenue growth and sustainability.
   

  

 Delta’s people\-first culture continues to be recognized, earning the airline a spot on
 **Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For®** 
 list for the fifth year. Delta is the only airline included on the 2024 list.
   

  

 Additionally, Delta earned a coveted spot, on
 **Fast Company** 
 ’s list of the
 **Most Innovative Companies,** 
 climbing from its No. 8 spot in 2023 to No. 2 in the travel category. The airline was recognized for its Wi\-Fi revolution that is working to ensure the future of travel is connected.
   

  

**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
 Delta has fast emerged as a customer\-focused, innovation\-led, technology\-enabled business. The Delta Technology Hub will contribute directly to these objectives. It will sustain our long\-term aspirations of delivering niche, IP\-intensive, high\-value, and innovative solutions. It supports various teams and functions across Delta and is an integral part of our transformation agenda, working seamlessly with a distributed team to create memorable experiences for customers.
   

  

**“Why join?”:**
* Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience.
* Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.
* Collaborate with research, innovation and IP co\-development partners.
* Immerse yourself in an employee\-centric culture.
* Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting\-edge technology driven solutions.

title: HR Assistant Manager
description:
* **Recruitment and Onboarding:**HR Generalists often play a key role in the hiring process, from writing job descriptions and posting openings to screening resumes and coordinating interviews. They also manage the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the company.
* **Employee Relations:**This includes addressing employee concerns, mediating conflicts, and providing guidance on performance management and disciplinary actions.
* **Compliance:**HR Generalists ensure that the organization adheres to all relevant employment laws and regulations, including updating policies and procedures as needed.
* **Benefits Administration:**They assist with the administration of employee benefits programs, such as health insurance and retirement plans.
* **HRIS Management:**Many HR Generalists are responsible for maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date employee records within HR information systems.
* **Policy Implementation:**They help develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring they are effectively communicated and followed.
* **Training and Development:**HR Generalists may also be involved in coordinating or delivering training programs for employees.
* **Performance Management:**They may assist with performance evaluations and provide guidance to managers on performance management practices.
* **Offboarding:**HR Generalists manage the offboarding process for departing employees, including exit interviews and paperwork.
* **Data Management:**They maintain accurate and confidential HR records and documentation.
* **Employee Engagement:**HR Generalists support initiatives aimed at improving employee morale and engagement.

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a **Program Operations Manager** to support the effective implementation of Lighthouse Programs by strengthening documentation, reporting, internal coordination, and team support functions. This role is critical in ensuring program efficiency, operational excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making through strong qualitative and quantitative insights.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, proactive, and possesses strong communication and analytical skills, with experience working in the development or non\-profit sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

Documentation \& Reporting

Team Support \& HR Coordination

Data \& Program Insights

* Review program dashboards and MIS reports to identify trends, risks, and insights.
* Highlight key observations to support smooth program delivery and impact across Lighthouse centres.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Social Work, Development Studies, Public Policy, or a related field.
* Minimum **5 years of experience** in program operations or similar roles within the development or non\-profit sector.
* Strong written communication, documentation, and reporting skills in English.
* Comfort working with data using Excel or Google Sheets; basic data analysis skills required.

* Strong interpersonal and coordination skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
* Sensitivity and professionalism in handling HR\-related coordination and team engagement.

Since 2012 Tru Prime Pvt. Ltd. has operated Punjab’s largest 2000 head dairy farm, mostly HF, at Majara about 32km from and 8 km from Ahmedgarh.

The company now seeks to diversify into growing chamber multi\-tier organic mushroom cultivation using captive cow manure as the principal substrate component.

The venture will consist of multiple growing chambers cultivating a variety of mushrooms, including button, oyster, paddy straw and shiitake using internally generated spawn and industry leading practices.

The company will also develop and cultivate medicinal mushrooms.

Spent mushroom substrate (SMS) will be processed in an accompanying vermicomposting facility.

title: HR Manager
description:
**A bit about us**
------------------


Trek is an awesome place to work, with amazing benefits for all employees. We build only products we love, provide incredible hospitality to our customers, and change the world by getting more people on bikes. When you’re on our team, you’re taken care of, encouraged to learn and grow, and given lots of opportunities to do so. Give us your best, and we’ll give it right back. Sound pretty sweet? Then come join us!

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Title: HR Manager**
=========================

**Location: Gurgaon, India**
============================

**Job type: Full time**
=======================

**Reports To: Country Head**
============================

**Work hours: min. 40 hours per week, Mon\-Fri, 3\-days Work from Office each week**
====================================================================================

**Role Overview**


The HR Manager will support and execute the Human Resources function for Trek India. This role requires a hands\-on professional who will personally manage and deliver core HR activities across the employee lifecycle while supporting strategic HR initiatives driven by Senior Leadership.


The HR Manager will be responsible for day\-to\-day HR operations, talent acquisition support, employee onboarding, training coordination, employee relations, HR data and compliance, and performance cycle administration. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being deeply involved in execution.

**Objectives of the role**

* Executing HR processes that support Trek India’s people strategy and business objectives.
* Managing operational HR activities including employee lifecycle management, HR documentation, HRIS updates, and compliance.
* Leading the talent acquisition \& independently handling offer negotiations.
* Leading onboarding, induction, and training coordination for all new hires.
* Driving employee engagement activities and supporting culture\-building initiatives.
* Providing HR data, analytics, and reports to assist decision\-making.
* Acting as the first point of contact for employee queries on policies \& procedures
* Overseeing employee training and development programs to enhance skills and career growth.
* Fostering a positive organizational culture that promotes employee engagement, diversity, and inclusion.
* Ensuring compliance with Indian labor laws and regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**


HR Administration \& Compliance

* Create and manage the HR budget, ensuring efficient use of resources.
* Lead and mentor the TA \& Admin team
* Maintain accurate employee data, records, and HRIS updates.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws, statutory requirements, and internal policies.


HR Policy Implementation

* Ensure employees understand and follow HR policies.
* Update policies and communicate changes.
* Analyze HR metrics and reports


Talent Acquisition

* Design and implement talent acquisition strategies that align with the company’s hiring needs
* Work closely with the Talent Acquisition (TA) team to fulfill staffing requirements.
* Own offer negotiation, compensation discussions, and issuance of offer letters.
* Ensure smooth coordination between hiring managers and TA team.


Onboarding, Induction \& Training

* Manage end\-to\-end onboarding processes (documentation, systems setup, day\-one coordination).
* Coordinate functional training plans in collaboration with managers and external partners


Employee Relations \& Engagement

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee queries and grievance resolution.
* Work closely with managers to drive performance conversations and employee development.
* Design initiatives to enhance employee engagement and retention.
* Manage employee relations and resolve conflicts effectively.
* Develop competitive compensation structures and benefits programs.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in HR Management or related field.
* 9\-12 years of experience in HR generalist, HR operations, Talent Acquisition, or similar hands\-on HR roles.
* At least 3 years’ experience leading HR / Admin teams
* Strong understanding of HR processes, Indian labour laws, and statutory compliance.
* Experience in handling onboarding, induction, and training coordination.
* Proficiency in HRIS tools, MS Office, and HR documentation.
* Hands\-on experience in “Workday”
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong negotiation skills for handling offers and compensation discussions.
* High attention to detail \& strong organizational skills
* Demonstrated ability to work hands\-on and get things done
* Experience in developing and managing HR budgets.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural environment.

**Why Trek?**

* Trek Bicycle in Fortune Rankings: (https://fortune.com/company/trek\-bicycle/)
	+ Ranked 4 in Best Large Workplaces in Retail
	+ Ranked 19 in World’s 25 Vest Workplaces
	+ Ranked 50 in Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For
	+ Ranked 65 in Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For – Europe
* GPTW (Great Place To Work) Certified (https://www.greatplacetowork.in/great/company/trek\-bikes)
* Best Workplaces in Asia 2025
* Flexible and fun company culture that values people, purpose, and performance
* A leadership team that supports autonomy and innovation
* A company that believes work should be fun, fulfilling, and impactful
* The chance to be part of something bigger \- changing the world by getting more people on bikes

**Trek India benefits:**

* Group medical insurance floater policy that covers self, spouse, up to 2 children and dependent parents
* 13 Annual paid holidays

By the end of this program, you will be able to design, build, secure, test, and deploy scalable backend applications used in real\-world products.

* Modules system (CommonJS vs ES Modules)
* Streams and buffers
* File system operations
* Error handling best practices
* Performance optimization techniques

You will understand how Node.js actually works under the hood, not just how to use it.

3\. Express.js Professional Level

* Advanced routing patterns
* Middleware architecture
* Custom middleware creation
* Request validation and sanitization
* Global error handling
* API versioning strategy

You will learn how to structure production\-grade Express applications.

4\. Database Mastery

* MongoDB with Mongoose (advanced schema design)

* Indexing and query optimization
* Data relationships and aggregation pipelines
* Transactions and ACID concepts

5\. Authentication and Security

* JWT authentication (access and refresh tokens)
* Role\-based access control
* OAuth integration
* Password hashing with bcrypt
* Rate limiting and brute\-force protection
* CORS configuration
* Secure API design principles
* OWASP security best practices

You will learn how to build secure backend systems used in real applications.

6\. Advanced API Development

* Pagination, filtering, sorting
* File uploads with Multer
* Email and SMS integration
* Payment gateway integration
* API documentation with Swagger
* GraphQL fundamentals
* WebSockets and real\-time applications

You will move beyond CRUD and build dynamic, real\-time systems.

7\. Testing and Code Quality

* Unit testing with Jest
* Integration testing
* API testing
* Mocking and stubbing
* Code coverage
* Debugging strategies
* Logging with Winston or Morgan

You will write backend code that is reliable and production\-ready.

8\. DevOps and Deployment

* Environment configuration
* Docker basics for backend
* CI/CD fundamentals
* Deploying to VPS
* Deploying to AWS
* Using PM2 for process management
* Reverse proxy with Nginx

You will learn how to take your backend from local machine to live server.

9\. Microservices and Advanced Architecture

* Monolith vs Microservices
* Service\-to\-service communication
* Message queues (Redis, RabbitMQ)
* Caching strategies
* Load balancing concepts
* Horizontal scaling
* API Gateway pattern

You will understand how large\-scale systems are built.

10\. Performance and Scalability

* Memory management
* Clustering in Node.js
* Handling high traffic APIs
* Database indexing strategy
* Caching with Redis
* Profiling and monitoring

You will be able to optimize applications for real\-world traffic.

Projects You Will Build

* Production\-ready REST API with full testing

Each project is designed to simulate real client requirements.

Who This Course Is For

After completing this course, you will:

description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

**Senior Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist**
----------------------------------------------------


**Experience**: Minimum 4 years  

**Location**: Koramangala, Bangalore  

**Work Mode**: In\-office  

**Work Schedule**: Its Tuesday to Saturday working, Sunday\-Monday are the week off



Contractual role for 6 months.


### **About the Role**



We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on Senior Recruiter to lead and execute high\-volume hiring initiatives. This role requires strong expertise in bulk hiring, hiring drive management, and the ability to manage and mentor HR interns while working closely with business and operations teams.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Plan, organize, and execute large\-scale hiring drives (virtual and on\-ground).
* Manage bulk hiring for Operations and other frontline roles.
* Lead and manage a team of HR interns, including task allocation, training, and daily performance tracking.
* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment processes: sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding coordination.
* Will be managing a team of HR interns
* Design and roll out attractive and effective employee referral bonus programs to boost hiring outcomes.
* Leverage AI\-based recruitment tools and modern sourcing techniques to improve hiring efficiency (preferred).
* Collaborate closely with hiring managers to understand manpower needs, timelines, and priorities.
* Maintain recruitment data, dashboards, and hiring reports for leadership review.

Ensure a smooth and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.  
* 

### **Required Qualifications \& Skills**


* Minimum 4 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition.
* Strong experience in bulk hiring and hiring drive management, especially for Operations / Sales etc
* Proven experience in managing and mentoring HR interns or junior recruiters.
* Hands\-on experience with ATS platforms and recruitment tools; exposure to AI hiring tools is a plus.
* Ability to conceptualize and execute lucrative referral programs.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

### **Why Join Us**


* High ownership role with end\-to\-end hiring responsibility
* Opportunity to lead and build a recruitment team
* Fast\-paced, high\-growth environment
* Direct exposure to leadership and strategic hiring decisions
* Competitive compensation, perks like commute, food
**Our Values**


* **Empathy, Trust \& Candor**  

We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* **Bias for Action**  

We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* **Always Be Learning**  

We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* **Act Like an Owner**  

We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**



Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!



Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.



Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.  

  

Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

As one of the fastest\-growing companies in our industry, we take pride in fostering a culture of innovation where new ideas are always welcomed—without hesitation. We are driven and expect the same dedication from our team members. Our speed, agility, and dedication set us apart, and we perform best when surrounded by high\-energy, driven individuals.  

To continue our rapid growth and deliver an even greater impact, we invite you to apply for our open positions and become part of our journey! **About the role:**  

We are seeking an experienced Finance Manager to oversee and manage the financial operations of our company. Calfus is headquartered in the US and has India operations in Pune and Bangalore and a subsidiary in Canada. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in financial planning, analysis, and decision\-making to ensure the company's financial health and long\-term growth. **What You’ll Do:**  

Financial Planning \& Analysis: \-
* Develop and manage budgets, forecasts, and financial models.
* Analyze financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities to optimize costs.
* Provide actionable insights to support strategic decision\-making.

  



Business Partnering: \-
* Baseline key cost levers and collaborate with leaders to establish benchmarks for assisting in pricing, contract structuring, and margin analysis for large deals **including project profitability and profit margin.**
* Collaborate with delivery, sales, HR and other teams to support cross\-functional initiatives.

  



Accounting \& Compliance: \-
* Oversee day\-to\-day accounting operations, including accounts payable/receivable, payroll, and general ledger.
* Spearhead month end, quarter end and year end activities including accruals \& monthly analysis on the actuals vs provisions.
* Ensure compliance with India, US and Canadian tax regulations and financial reporting standards including coordination with auditors for periodic and annual audits.

  



Cash Flow \& Risk Management: \-
* Monitor and manage cash flow to ensure liquidity and operational efficiency.
* Identify financial risks and implement mitigation strategies.

  



Stakeholder Communication: \-

* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.
* Strong analytical skills and detail orientation. Ability to interpret data, generate and communicate insights.
* Proficient in advanced Microsoft Excel techniques.
* Effective written and oral communication skills with the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
* Ability to work independently, maintain confidentiality and collaborate effectively in a team environment.
* Individual will need to work across US and India time\-zones.

At Calfus, we value our employees and offer a strong benefits package. This includes medical, group, and parental insurance, coupled with gratuity and provident fund options. Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit. **Calfus Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Calfus Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes candidates from all backgrounds to apply. We encourage applications from individuals with diverse experiences and perspectives, as we believe in the power of a diverse and inclusive workforce to drive innovation and success.

title: HR Specialist, Global Operations
description:
**About Command\|Link**

  

Command\|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions, helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Command\|Link has revolutionized the IT industry by tackling the problems our competitors create. In recognition for our unprecedented innovation and dedication, Command\|Link was recognized as the SD\-WAN Product of the Year, ITSM Visionary Spotlight, UCaaS Product of the Year, NaaS Product of the Year, Supplier of the Year, and the AT\&T Strategic Growth Partner. Command\|Link has built the only IT platform for scale that solves ISP vendor sprawl and IT headaches. We make it easy for our customers to get more done, maximize uptime and improve the bottom line.

  

Learn more about us here!

 **This is a 100% remote position!**

 **About your new role:**


We’re looking for a detail\-oriented and resourceful HR Specialist to support our growing global workforce across multiple countries. This role plays an important part in ensuring smooth day\-to\-day HR operations for international employees and contractors engaged through global partners and internal HR systems.

  

You’ll work closely with the Director of HR to maintain compliant, organized, and efficient HR processes across regions. This is an operationally focused role for someone who brings structure to fast\-moving environments. While processes exist, priorities can shift quickly, and the right person will be comfortable operating in a growing, startup\-style organization where adaptability, ownership, and responsiveness are essential.

  

Beyond supporting existing processes, you’ll help monitor and strengthen HR automation workflows, identify inefficiencies, and contribute ideas that improve speed, accuracy, and scalability. We’re looking for someone with a systems\-oriented mindset who is comfortable leveraging modern tools, including AI, to enhance productivity and drive smarter HR operations.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a primary HR contact for international employees and contractors, including those engaged through EOR service providers.
* Support onboarding logistics, documentation management, and new hire coordination across HR systems and EOR platforms.
* Maintain and organize employee personnel files, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and proper record retention.
* Assist with drafting offer letters and routing approvals through established workflows.
* Monitor HRIS automated workflows to ensure processes are running properly, troubleshoot issues, and recommend improvements.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes through automation, AI tools, and system enhancements.
* Support employee benefits coordination and related documentation, including inquiries routed through EOR providers.
* Support time\-off tracking and policy administration.
* Maintain and update HR documentation, knowledge base resources, and organizational reporting (e.g., org charts).
* Track employment law updates in countries where we operate and coordinate with EOR partners as needed.
* Provide recruiting coordination support on an as\-needed basis (e.g., scheduling assistance, posting documentation).
* Assist in planning and coordinating local team\-building initiatives and employee engagement activities within regional teams.
* Perform other duties and projects as assigned to support the HR function and broader organization.
* Takes on additional responsibilities and projects as needed to support the success of the team and organization.

 **What you'll need for success:**

* 2–4 years of experience in Human Resources or People Operations.
* Experience supporting international employees through EOR service providers (e.g., Deel) preferred.
* Exposure to multi\-country workforce operations and global compliance considerations.
* Foundational knowledge of HR compliance and employment law.
* Familiarity with HRIS platforms (e.g., Rippling) and comfort navigating multiple systems.
* Highly detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills.
* Process\-driven mindset with the ability to follow structured workflows while thinking critically about improvements.
* Strong sense of data integrity, confidentiality, and discretion when handling sensitive employee information.
* Comfort using technology to improve efficiency, with curiosity around automation and AI\-driven tools.
* Resourceful, creative problem\-solver who can think beyond “how it’s always been done.”
* Strong written communication skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

 **Why you'll love life at Command\|Link**


Join us at CommandLink, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of business communication. We value the innovative spirit and seek individuals ready to bring their unique vision and expertise to a team that values bold ideas and strategic thinking. Are you ready to make an impact?

* Room to grow at a high\-growth company
* An environment that celebrates ideas and innovation
* Your work will have a tangible impact
* Flexible time off
* Fun events at cool locations
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team

  

At CommandLink, we’re committed to creating a fair, consistent, and efficient hiring experience. As part of our process, we use AI\-assisted tools to help review and analyze applications. These tools support our recruiting team by identifying qualifications and experience that align with the requirements of each role.

  

AI tools are used only to assist in the evaluation process — they do not make final hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting or hiring team before any decisions are made.

description:
We are seeking a detail\-oriented and organized **Documentation \& Cost Control Executive** to manage project documentation, cost analysis, site coordination, and reporting activities. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, good coordination ability, and experience in handling technical documentation for site\-based projects.

Key Responsibilities Documentation \& Reporting

* Prepare and update **Site Work Conclusion Reports** after completion of each project.
* Prepare **Welding Reports** based on actual site data and received reports.
* Prepare **Daily and Weekly Site Reports** and submit them to the concerned authority.
* Collect and update **Work Progress Reports** from Salespersons and Project Engineers.
* Ensure proper documentation and filing of all site\-related updates, reports, and approvals.
* Maintain and file all **Certificates** related to materials, machines, or personnel.
* Obtain required signatures from Salespersons or Project Engineers on site reports and update the master file.

Cost Control \& Analysis

* Perform **Cost Analysis** based on allocated rates for each work order.
* Prepare and maintain **Supplementary Cost Sheets** for all work orders.
* Conduct **Work Order Analysis** to ensure machine and material readiness before project start.
* Prepare quotations based on site visits or drawings and obtain confirmation from management before final approval.

Operations Coordination

* Maintain and regularly update the **Machine Checklist** for operational readiness.
* Verify machine tools and certificates before dispatching to site.
* Arrange required machines and materials in advance for scheduled work.
* Manage machine requests and ensure timely deployment to site.
* Prepare **Job Sheets** for each project (minimum 10\-day schedule) in coordination with Sales or Project Engineers.
* Prepare and manage the **Duty Chart** for assigned personnel.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Commerce, Management, or a related discipline.
* 0–3 years of experience in documentation, cost control, or project coordination. Freshers are also encouraged to apply.
* Strong knowledge of **MS Excel** and reporting formats.
* Good coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
* Experience in MEP / construction / industrial projects will be preferred.
* Candidate should have a **personal laptop** and a **reliable internet connection at home** (in case work\-from\-home is required).

* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain

title: Role - Robotics Arm - Mechanical
description:
Please find the below details for your ref

**Role** \- Mechanical Design Engineer \- Robotic Arm

**Location**: Bangalore South (**Jigani**)

**Work mode**: On\-site (preferred) / Hybrid (as applicable)

**Experience**: 1 – 5 years (Max)

**Domain**: Industrial Robotics / Autonomous Manipulation

**Company Overview:**

Rx100 Ventures is a sector\-focused deep tech venture firm headquartered in Bangalore, India. We partner with startups at the intersection of industrial innovation, deep tech, and digital transformation, providing capital and strategic direction to accelerate their growth.

**About the Role**

We’re building an Autonomous Industrial Robotic Arm in the 5–7 DOF range with payload \<250 kg and hiring a Mechanical Design Engineer to take hardware from concept → CAD → prototype → validation → production release. This is a hands\-on role focused on precision mechanisms and joint module engineering, not general CAD drafting.

**What You’ll Do** 

· Design arm joints, links, housings/covers, and end\-effector mechanical interfaces for a multi\-DOF industrial arm

· Own joint module design: BLDC motor \+ harmonic/planetary gearbox integration, bearing/shaft/fastener sizing, housing architecture, sealing (IP\-rated where required), thermal paths/heat sinking, and robust cable routing/strain relief

· Create production\-grade engineering drawings: GD\&T, datums, fits, tolerance stack\-ups, and release packs (BOM \+ rev control)

· Support prototype builds and iteration cycles: assembly debugging, RCA, fixture/jig requirements, reliability improvements

· Drive DFM/DFA with suppliers (machining, sheet metal, castings, heat\-treat, surface finishing), RFQs, and drawing clarifications

· Collaborate with controls/electronics/firmware teams on packaging constraints, sensor mounts, and mechatronic interfaces.

**Must\-Have Requirements** 

· 1 plus years of mechanical design experience in robotics / industrial automation / precision machinery / mechatronics

· Strong fundamentals: mechanisms, materials, manufacturing, fits \& tolerances

· Proficiency in 3D CAD \+ drawings

· CAD: Autodesk Fusion 360 / Autodesk Inventor and/or SolidWorks / Creo / NX

· Drawings: GD\&T, tolerance stack\-up, datum strategy

· Experience with actuator \& transmission integration: motors/gearboxes, bearings, shafts, housings, fasteners

**Good\-to\-Have** 

· Experience with robot arms (5–7 axis), heavy/industrial manipulators, or servo\-driven jointed mechanisms

· Familiarity with harmonic drive / planetary gearbox / cycloidal concepts, encoder integration, lubrication, serviceability

· Working knowledge of FEA/CAE (e.g., ANSYS or equivalent) for stiffness/deflection and basic modal checks

· Exposure to IP sealing, thermal management around motors/drives, and production validation practices

**This Role Is NOT For**

Profiles limited to 2D drafting or architecture/interiors/civil CAD

Pure simulation\-only roles without ownership of mechanical design deliverables

Freshers / interns

ROS / ROS2 development

Move It, Gazebo\-based simulation work

SLAM or autonomous navigation systems

Computer Vision implementation

AI / ML\-centric roles

Pure software engineering roles

Simulation\-only responsibilities without physical product ownership

title: Community Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Calyp is a deep\-tech startup, based in Germany, building next\-generation human–computer interaction products at the intersection of brain–computer interface (BCI), consumer technology, and Augmented Reality (AR).

We are transitioning from a research\-focused phase into a consumer\-facing brand, and we are looking for someone who can help us grow a lively, authentic, and engaging online community around our story, products, and vision.

This role is best suited for someone who enjoys creating content, interacting with people online, and thinking like a digital community builder rather than a traditional marketer.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Community \& Social Presence Builder who loves the internet culture of content, conversations, and creator\-driven growth.

This is a hands\-on, early\-stage startup role where you will have the freedom to experiment, build your creative style, and directly shape how people see and interact with Calyp online.

If you are someone who already creates content, enjoys social media trends, tech enthusiast or wants to grow as a digital creator, this role will feel natural to you.

**What You Will Do**

**Community Building \& Engagement**

* Grow and energise Calyp’s presence on platforms such as LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Discord, and other relevant communities
* Actively engage with followers, comments, and discussions
* Help build a positive, curious, and vibrant community around technology and innovation
* Moderate and participate in community conversations

**Content \& Creator\-Style Storytelling**

* Ideate and create engaging posts, reels, and short\-form content
* Create engaging content around tech, startups and innovation
* Think in terms of hooks, storytelling, and shareable ideas
* Support launch campaigns, product updates, and founder insights
* Maintain a consistent but human and authentic brand voice

**Community Communication \& Updates**

* Help prepare newsletters and updates
* Coordinate content from research, product, and founder teams

**Basic Marketing \& Outreach Support**

* Prepare simple marketing materials (presentations, one\-pagers, outreach messages)
* Assist with simple CRM or lead coordination (training will be provided)

**Who We Are Looking For**

* Someone genuinely excited about social media, communities, and online conversations
* Creator mindset \> corporate marketing mindset
* Comfortable using Instagram, X, and LinkedIn
* Good written communication skills in English
* Self\-driven and reliable

*No prior corporate experience is required.*

**Big Plus If You**

* Create content on any platform (influencer, creator, or hobby page is fine)
* Have managed a brand, club, or community page before
* Understand engagement psychology — hooks, trends, and audience interaction
* Are curious about startups, technology, or innovation culture

**What You Get**

* Ownership of social and community presence for a growing startup
* Direct mentorship from founders
* Freedom to experiment creatively
* Opportunity to grow into a higher responsibility and compensation role as Calyp scales

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Your LinkedIn profile
* Links to social media pages or content you have created or managed
* Have you managed or contributed to an online community (Discord, Slack, Facebook Group, etc.)? \[Yes / No]
* What makes this job interesting to you?

description:
**HR Generalist** 




**Location:** 
 Kandla, Gujarat
 



**Reports To:** 
 Functionally to Group Vice President\-HR; Administratively to Terminal Head
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 The HR Generalist will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day human resource operations, statutory compliance, and labour relations in line with applicable labour laws and factory regulations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




**Statutory Compliance \& Labour Law Administration** 



* Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of statutory licences and registrations under the Factories Act and related rules.
* Manage submission of statutory returns such as Form 11A and other applicable forms.
* Administer and monitor compliance with Minimum Wages Act, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, and Payment of Gratuity, PF, Bonus and other related legislations.
* Maintain and implement Model Standing Orders and ensure adherence to internal policies in line with statutory requirements.
* Handle provisions under the Industrial Disputes Act (ID Act) including Notice of Change and Settlement procedures.
* Coordinate and represent the company during inspections by statutory and labour authorities.



  





**Employee Relations \& HR Operations** 



* Oversee time office routines, including attendance, leave, and overtime (OT) management.
* Manage leave administration and leave encashment processes as per company policy and statutory norms.
* Maintain employee records, personal files, and statutory registers.
* Handle grievance redressal, employee discipline, and counsel employees to maintain a positive work environment.
* Support the HR HOD in implementing employee engagement initiatives and welfare activities.



  





**Discipline \& Industrial Relations** 



* Support enforcement of company rules and standing orders to maintain workplace discipline.
* Assist in handling employee misconduct cases and preliminary inquiries in coordination with the management.
* Participate in settlement negotiations and assist in drafting and maintaining records of agreements.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience**



* Education: Graduate / Postgraduate in HR, Industrial Relations, or Labour Welfare.
* Experience: 8 to 12 years of experience in HR operations or compliance, preferably in a manufacturing or plant environment.
* Knowledge: In\-depth understanding of Indian labour laws, factory compliance, and HR administrative procedures.



  





**Skills \& Competencies**



* Strong knowledge of statutory labour laws and compliance.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and HRMS/payroll software.
* Attention to detail, integrity, and ability to handle confidential information.

 We’re looking for a dynamic UK/India HR Manager with Learning and Development focus, and people experience for our growing workforce. This role blends operational excellence with strategic HR partnership — from training to payroll and benefits governance to employee engagement, compensation frameworks, and performance programs across multiple countries. This role will also own and deliver high\-impact learning experiences across Veremark, including creating the framework, strategies, contents deliverables (partnering with key business owners) and delivering the training.
 



 As the UK/India HR Manager, you will lead HR operations with Learning and Development/Training focus and strategic people initiatives across the UK, India workforces, with potential expansion into newer geographies in Europe. You will be responsible for compliance, employee lifecycle management, and partnering with business leaders to drive talent strategies aligned with Veremark’s growth.
 



  





**Duties and Responsibilities** 




 Employee Lifecycle Management
 


* Support employee life cycle activities from on\-boarding, day to day support, to off\-boarding stages
* Offer support and guidance to employees on HR policies, procedures, welfare and benefits programs, insurance claims, and other HR\-related administrative matters
* Manage and maintain each new hire’s personal folder from the pre\-onboarding phase through the end of their probation period
* Promote a positive work environment through employee initiatives and to create a holistic employee experience
* Manage benefits in kind such as birthdays, special occasions, work anniversaries etc.
* Act as a point of contact for employee HR\-related queries
* Review, develop, update, and implement HR policies, procedures, and the employee handbook to ensure compliance with labour laws and regulation
* Oversee the annual insurance renewal process and monthly update to vendor



  





 HR Training and System Management
 


* Build and develop internal training framework, content, and structure
* Analyze training, learning and development gaps within the organization
* Assist in planning, sourcing and publishing/promoting internally learning and development programs
* Serve as the primary training coordinator/trainer within HR, handling the scheduling of sessions while collaborating with HR counterparts to ensure invitations for sessions and other key events are properly distributed
* Facilitate training sessions for local employees/workers on various contents such as client onboarding, sales training, HR systems, tools, and outward mindset initiatives; company cultures; or as assigned.
* Partner with IT to ensure security trainings are 100% completion rate



  





 Merger and Acquisition
 


* Act as the catalyst for cultural integration across UK entities and newly acquired businesses, post\-integration, ensuring alignment with Veremark’s Core Values and operating principles.
* Lead the people and culture integration strategy during mergers and acquisition, conducting cultural diagnostics, identifying gaps, and designing structured integration roadmaps.
* Serve as the HR change agent, driving organisational alignment, harmonisation of policies, and consistent employee experience across merged entities.
* Bridge cultural, operational, and behavioural differences by facilitating and alignment workshops, communication frameworks, and change engagement initiatives.
* Partner with executive stakeholders to unify teams under a shared identity, shared goals, and common performance standards.



  





 Compensation Strategy \& Framework
 


* Ability to design and support a competitive global compensation framework, covering fixed pay and variable incentive programs.
* Develop and implement internal salary bands and job grading structures aligned with market dynamics, balancing standardization and flexibility.
* Conduct market research and benchmarking to continuously enhance compensation competitiveness.
* Support VP of People \& Culture to develop diverse incentive programs aligned with company growth and workforce needs.
* Monitor program effectiveness and optimize reward mechanisms to enhance business impact and employee engagement.
* Develop diverse incentive programs aligned with company growth and workforce needs.
* Monitor program effectiveness and optimize reward mechanisms to enhance business impact and employee engagement



  





 Performance Management
 


* Support performance review cycle and systems adapted to global and remote teams (OKRs, project\-based reviews, 360 feedback, etc.).
* Partner with HRD to drive goal setting, ongoing coaching, and performance reviews, ensuring fair and transparent evaluation.
* Design incentive mechanisms linked to performance outcomes to strengthen alignment between contribution and rewards.



  





 Others
 


* Monitor vendor management based on Service level agreement (SLA), raise POs, validate invoices for processing, and oversee the renewal/non\-renewal of agreements
* Participate in HR projects/initiatives and provide support in tasks as assigned, e.g. Payroll project
* Serves as back up to team member(s) in area(s) as assigned

* Minimum 10 years of HR Generalist experience, with high focus on developing and building Learning \& Development, training functions in major start\-ups
* System and tech savvy is highly desirable
* Familiar with UK employment laws, India employment laws, payroll and HR operations
* Accountable and willing to take ownership for 100% data accuracy
* Adaptable and agile to manage changes, thrive in ambiguity
* Exhibits service mindset and passionate about assisting employees with their HR needs
* Humble, able to show empathy when handling employee issues and self\-reflect
* Strong interpersonal and communications skills and be at ease to deal with employees from all levels
* Effective collaborator and able to work across departments to achieve business goals
* Excellent business acumen, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Highly accountable, self\-driven, and able to thrive in a fast\-paced, evolving environment



  





 Academic Qualifications
 


* Diploma or degree in HR/Business administration
